partners.mechanism_chain: SCNN1A (HGNC:10618) —DISRUPTS→ Sodium reabsorption (GO:0006816); Sodium reabsorption (GO:0006816) —LEADS_TO→ Pseudohypoaldosteronism, type IB1 (MONDO:0009917); CASQ2 (HGNC:2042) —DISRUPTS→ Calcium homeostasis (GO:0005389); Calcium homeostasis (GO:0005389) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiac action potential regulation (GO:0003010); Cardiac action potential regulation (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia 2 (MONDO:0012762). Loss-of-function mutations in SCNN1A disrupt sodium reabsorption, leading to pseudohypoaldosteronism. Separately, loss-of-function mutations in CASQ2 disrupt calcium homeostasis, which in turn impacts cardiac action potential regulation, leading to catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia. The convergence is hypothesized to be at the level of cellular ion balance and cardiac electrophysiology, where dysregulation of sodium handling by SCNN1A can indirectly affect the cellular environment critical for calcium handling by CASQ2, and vice versa.

partners.mechanism_chain: SCNN1A (HGNC:10612) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial sodium transport (GO:0007182); Epithelial sodium transport (GO:0007182) —LEADS_TO→ Salt wasting (HP:0002169); ANO1 (HGNC:12795) —DISRUPTS→ Calcium-activated chloride channel activity (GO:0005279); Calcium-activated chloride channel activity (GO:0005279) —DISRUPTS→ Endothelial cell function and vascular tone regulation (GO:0007169); Endothelial cell function and vascular tone regulation (GO:0007169) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebral small vessel disease (HP:0030676).
